title: Primed flight lance: three new builds (409 P1 variations)
desc: J rated 409 P1 (hex lance + twin helix) IMPROVE with no note, so three new builds of the primed lance. Each flies 2 s as the thin fast-flight cap, then primes (cap folds away in 4 ticks, the lance snaps on with a flash ring). Fast flat glide, 1 block a tick.

takes.name: Primed: nested hex rings + braid
takes.facts: flies as the fast cap, primes at 2 s: seven hex frames stacked into a lance (1.2 blocks wide at the hips to a point 4 ahead), turning in alternating directions inside a faint hex hull; three ribbons braid in behind and pull tight

takes.name: Primed: crystal facets + peeling shards
takes.facts: flies as the fast cap, primes at 2 s: three layers of separate dark-jade kite facets with gaps and lit edges round an eight-sided spear that turns slowly; flat diamond shards peel off the back and tumble away

takes.name: Primed: twin crossed blades + streaks
takes.facts: flies as the fast cap, primes at 2 s: two crossed leaf blades with a bright centre line, turning one way; four long thin streaks trail from the blade tails
